Each route has method, body/query, status and error contracts; public documents are separated from private buffers, model parts and profiles.
Document, run, activity and dashboard stores are explicitly process-memory state with restart loss and missing-ID404 behavior.
Upload reservations and whole-batch rollback are specified; retained-run references protect documents with DELETE409.
Origin checks, middleware order, JSON and multipart limits, and413 versus400 errors have concrete boundaries.
Startup and signal shutdown specify port/host/dist, cancel-all, server.close and exit0; absent cleanup supervision and deadlines are honestly scoped with process-test requirements.
Supported extensions, roles, filename sanitation, signature/ZIP/UTF8 checks and original-byte preservation are explicit.
Compatibility and drawing removal affect a copy only; formula-cache sentinels, merged masters and original analysis remain distinct.
Local limits yield an exact accepted deferred-preview DTO, discard partial source sheets and retain original bytes for sandbox analysis.
Reservation-before-parse, concurrent100-document/250MiB capacity, release/rollback and ZIP boundaries are specified.
The exact drawing warning and image-only fallback are specified; omission alone does not set truncated. Formula-cache and PDF auxiliary-read failure signals are also explicit.
Concrete reader, stored/analyzed document, model-part, source-sheet/row and inventory DTOs connect profile conversion to digest/kind validation.
Physical sandbox identity owns preparation promises; retained rereads share one session and local TaskPool1 without repeating installation.
Document wall time, reader soft limit, command/create/kill deadlines and cleanup activity ownership are distinct.
Reader limits and partial/unsupported/hard-error branches cannot be mistaken for full source completion.

Typed selectors, range/order limits, digest/kind validation and concrete reread response DTOs are specified.

Repair replaces at most160 structures, distinct from merged1000; validated recovery clears initial missing-segment state while preserving history and source truncation.

evidence.section: 문맥 replacement와 구간 복구의 정확한 크기 계약

checks.reason: Incomplete or mismatched selections produce source_limit/limited; exceptions or invalid replacements retain context with needs_review unless source_limit applies. Abort propagates.
Structural, sparse, shifted, transposed, hidden and no-progress cases define coverage behavior without relying on filenames or row-count guesses.
Page/table/cell geometry, nesting, blank pages and coverage have separate transcription and judge schemas with numerical limits.
Independent verification compares original visuals with transcription and checks page identity, geometry, overlap and blank-page reasons.
Page-local replacement, bounded rounds/deadlines, retry eligibility and stopReason precedence are specified.
Page/image/output limits and uncertain content retain partial state rather than fabricate text or completion.
Negative cases cover invented or mixed pages, invalid parents, false blank approval and independent-verifier failures.
Eligibility combinations and excluded public fields are closed; private Word block/PDF table provenance is separated from public quote/page citations.
Only fully verified not_criteria documents can be excluded; complete reading and source quality are explicit, while mixed documents retain genuine reusable rules.
Only invalid schema/citations get one repair; transient uncertainty and abort differ, and excluded sources cannot re-enter candidates, approval or revision.
Names, roles and summaries are not evidence; exact normalized quotes, numeric boundaries, range/comment grounding and input caps prevent false exclusion.
Legal, business, qualitative, retrospective, external-reference, mixed and injection cases have filename-independent expected classifications.
Inventory regions, samples, detail reads, plans, dispositions, region assessments and citations have distinct DTOs and complete region accounting.
Discovery supplements omitted sparse regions and specifies two orientations, transposed/merged blocks, separated bounds and actual header roles.
Discovery creates a separate physical sandbox after structural analysis; only inventory data may carry over, while its two detail rounds reuse that discovery session.
Inventory/detail/range/coordinate/output caps distinguish unique returned cells, record JSON size and repeated coordinate budget, preserving partial coverage.
Rename, shift, transpose, hidden, adjacent-table and condition/note transformations define equivalent or intentionally changed source/coverage outcomes.
Rule, comparison, units, scope, hierarchy, sample and conditions have distinct provenance; absent and unresolved types have explicit representations.
Actual note-role cells are excluded while genuine conditions are recovered. Same-label sourceEvidence limitations and required unique-row corrections have separate fixtures.
Shared/child/sample and replacement priorities are specified; mandatory HIERARCHY_SCOPE_V2 distinguishes owned applicability headings from generic titles.
Size/depth/text bounds and current invalid-grounding behavior are explicit; mandatory additional cases require conservative confirmation instead of hidden guessing.
Variable hierarchies, arbitrary materials, unitless qualitative rules and same-label/different-condition cases are tested without filename or material-name branches.
Confirm/revise carry the current draft, feedback, source/scope and expected version; approved clone/version/time and feedback history are typed.
Editable meaning is separated from server provenance. REQUIRED_PATCH_V2 handles required:boolean with consistent rule text, preserved unrelated fields and human reapproval.
Revision success/failure, confirmation return, confirmation-to-target transition and version/revision increments are explicit.
Missing/stale versions, feedback limits, scoped-source validation and cancellation/revision guards close late-response races.
Preapproval targets are rejected; approved criteria are cloned/frozen with server version and provenance/audit preserved.
Independent visual facts300 and review items250 per document use different schemas and calls; facts extraction is explicitly PDF/image-only.
Facts preserve actual observations, samples, report identity, zero/unit/ND notation independently of approved limits.
Analysis, visual facts, semantic proposal, ordered normalization, item events and coverage have a defined sequence.
Invalid IDs/shapes fail the document; uncertainty, different records, conditions and independent-fact mismatches downgrade according to explicit precedence.
CSV/XLSX record blanks remain present; valid exclusions and missing rows are distinguished without claiming row coverage proves every criterion.
Numeric operators, inclusive ranges, exact unit normalization and status/machine/missing fields are specified without implicit unit conversion.
Missing failure requires complete reading, required applicability and actual absence evidence; uncertainty/ND/cache loss stay review and optional absence is omitted.
Ordered normalization prioritizes source, criterion, applicability, conditions and independent facts over numeric outcomes.
Literal hierarchy/sample, numeric boundaries, ordered components, specified pages and same-record source checks prevent label-only passes.
Deterministic vectors distinguish zero, blanks, merged continuation, absent cache, verified/unverified missing and conflicting extracted values.
Closed run/document/stage enums, modes, event sequence/time and exact document summary predicates are supplied.
Separate two-worker analysis/review stages define deduplication, sibling failure isolation and document-ID ownership independently of global pools.
Cancellation, late-run-event rejection, terminal aggregation and waiter isolation are explicit; late kill failure uses activity while the run stays cancelled.
Open runs are capped at3; insertion precedes pruning to total40. The250-item cap and incomplete-coverage partial state remain distinct.
Post-run human decisions require reasons and preserve original machine status, before/after audit, summary and item.resolved events.
Public citations, criterion/item identity, missing flags, PDF anchors and selection callbacks are distinct from private native table provenance.
Filters affect lists while highlights use every item linked to the selected source; owner counts and explicit transition traces prevent cross-document mixing.

Required DB-H01 preserves missing flags in frozen projections. Missing target contextual citations are suppressed for highlighting while explanatory evidence and grounded criterion-label recovery remain.

Required I9.1 specifies source hash, unique sheet, full bounds, exact cell quote/numeric boundaries, verified same-record anchor/unit and atomic rejection; twenty fixtures cover wrong cells, headers and ambiguity. PDF page admission is separately exact.
The revised acceptance matches source/origin/channel/type/token/item validation, immutable preview binding, listener cleanup and original-file exclusion from exports.
Activity identities, runtime/status, causal handoffs, sanitation and log bounds are defined; publication revision differs from run sequence and includes cleanup failures.
Global pools, engine queue, document workers and local commands have separate caps plus FIFO admission, abort checks and release after cleanup.
Terminal/cancel/cleanup publication and GET/SSE/recovery/disposal order are explicit.07 now agrees on supplied-array tail100 rather than newest100.
Channel framing, partial buffers, progress allowlists, dedup keys, stream/aggregate ownership, caps, heartbeat and scoped observation are concrete.
Auto-collapse defaults, causal eligibility, ordering, burst handling, pause/remainder and app OFF versus OS CSS reduction are specified without changing authoritative work state.
Export states and JSON/CSV/four-sheet XLSX fields retain final/machine decisions, reasons, evidence and audit.
User-selected report identity and real header/row mapping constrain two-cell changes in a copied workbook with ZIP/XML preservation.
Analyze, confirm and export bind to serialized proposal fields; note-only changes do not automatically invalidate fingerprints, as LED13/14 demonstrate.
Formula injection, ZIP/relationship paths, existing cells, incomplete results and sample allowlists have explicit rejection/preservation contracts.
Golden UI selection and v3 direct-input verification are distinguished, with oracle isolation, no answer/filename injection and metamorphic checks.
D05a enumerates five required and nine defaultable stored fields, legacy5/7 acceptance and null/invalid/extra rejection; generated designs require all14.

Mandatory DB-H02/03 use independent semantic judgment before approved-only host composition. Scope, exact spans, dependencies, preserved fields and negative cases are explicit, with model-quality limits separated from mechanical guarantees.

evidence.section: REQUIRED_REBUILD planner override and semantic judge

checks.reason: Planner, semantic judge and all retries share three total model calls. D05b defines parse failures, absent judge budget and constrained repair; one sandbox installation, generated/standard fallback/failed states and DELETE204 cancellation remain explicit.

Frozen review data and restricted plans prevent model code or verdict changes; host composition preserves unapproved fields, invalid input rejects and fixed notices disclose standard/partial fallback without rewriting unrelated titles.
DB-SEQ-01 gives sequential requests, full designs, preserved fields and canvas/style/count oracles; dark+compact control tests implicit meaning. Runtime status remains NOT_RUN.
Design attributes, CSS variables, chart configuration, standalone output and mount/update/destroy are defined by bounded included references.
Actual chart shape/size/theme/legend, selection/filter/details and snapshot identity/counts have eighteen complete browser-case plans and assertions.
Initial state, detail layout, motion precedence, runtime cleanup and retained hidden iframe life are distinct without invented visibility suspension.
Nonce/CSP, escaping, offline/sandbox/bridge checks and exact HTML/report readback prevent treating exit0 as sufficient validation.
Eleven DOM checks are separate from actual browser geometry, visibility, canvas and style evidence across named viewport branches.
Cache keys, owners, lifetimes, caps, invalidation and FIFO/write-recency distinctions are specified, including insert-before-prune40→41→40 retention.
Sparse inventory, orientations, sweep, dedup/matching/missing order and nested scans/parser memory/serialization costs are explicit; H denotes checked header citations.
Exact pool/queue/worker caps, FIFO/abort/cleanup order, same-sandbox boundaries, deadlines and nested-acquisition restrictions avoid undefined scheduling.
Bounded logs, replay, stale gates, handoffs and PDF/iframe lifetimes distinguish absent backpressure/batching/suspension; tail100 selection now agrees.
Byte/character/cell/page/time/token units, stop/partial semantics, negative gates and measurement protocol avoid unmeasured performance or completion claims.

issues.problem: XLSX 기준 탐색의 세션 소유권이 충돌한다. 02는 구조 분석 E2B를 항상 종료한 뒤 탐색 전용 세션을 시작하지만 03은 기존 분석 세션을 재사용한다고 한다.
alternativeInterpretations: 항상 구조 분석과 탐색에 별도 E2B 세션을 만든다.
분석 세션을 유지하여 기준 탐색에도 재사용한다.
issues.requiredDecision: 기준 파이프라인의 세션 생성·종료 책임을 하나로 고정하고 선택적 어댑터 재사용 기능과 구분한다.
issues.resolution: 03 §11.1 and 02 §2.1/2.8 now require a distinct discovery sandbox; only inventory data may be reused, while discovery detail rounds reuse that discovery session.

issues.problem: 같은 hierarchy prompt가 categoryPath를 shared section headings에서 보존하라고 하면서 section titles에서 category를 도출하지 말라고 한다. 적용 가능한 section heading과 금지된 title의 구분이 없다.
alternativeInterpretations: 실제 상위 섹션 제목을 유형 계층 근거로 수용한다.
섹션 제목에서 나온 유형을 모두 제외하고 표 머리글/열만 수용한다.
issues.requiredDecision: 업무상 유형·적용 범위를 가진 섹션 헤더와 일반 목차/문서 제목을 구별하는 조건 및 예시를 지정하고 프롬프트 충돌의 우선순위를 정한다.
issues.resolution: pipeline-prompts HIERARCHY_SCOPE_V2 is a mandatory reconstruction overlay distinguishing structurally owned applicability headings from generic document/TOC/section titles; algorithm-edge-cases provides positive and negative cases.

issues.problem: required는 편집 가능한 필드와 PATCH schema에 있지만 revision prompt의 허용 변경 목록과 모호성 해소 목록에는 없다. required=true 기준을 '선택 항목'으로 바꿔 달라는 요청에서 rule만 수정하면 §6의 명시 required 우선 정책 때문에 필수로 남는다.
alternativeInterpretations: 자연어 수정은 required:false를 직접 patch하여 선택 항목으로 바꾼다.
prompt 목록만 지켜 rule을 선택 사항으로 바꾸고 기존 required:true는 보존한다.
issues.requiredDecision: required의 자연어 수정 가능 여부를 명시하고 가능하면 prompt의 editable·semantic edit 목록에 포함하거나, 불가하면 사용자 메시지와 direct-edit 경로를 지정한다.
issues.resolution: 03 §13.2 and mandatory REQUIRED_PATCH_V2 explicitly permit required:boolean and require consistent optional prose, preservation of unrelated fields, provenance protection and another human confirmation.

issues.problem: summary의 문서 관련 네 필드는 이름만 있고 계산식이 없다. 특히 incompleteDocuments가 partial 문서만인지 failed/cancelled/queued/processing까지 포함한 비완료 문서인지 결정할 수 없다. 문서 status와 stage도 wire enum보다 느슨한 string으로 남아 있다.
alternativeInterpretations: incompleteDocuments는 status='partial'만 센다.
incompleteDocuments는 status!='completed'인 모든 문서를 센다.
issues.requiredDecision: 허용 문서 status/stage와 documents/completedDocuments/failedDocuments/incompleteDocuments의 정확한 predicate, 진행/취소 snapshot 예시를 명시한다.
issues.resolution: 01 §3/§10, types Summary and internal-pipeline RunDocumentStatus/RunStage enumerate wire states and all four document-count predicates, including partial-only incompleteDocuments.

issues.section: §13.1 native citation paragraph; contracts/types.ts Evidence; prompts/criteria-algorithms.catalog.json criteria-eligibility.SCHEMA
issues.problem: Word native citation은 documentId/block/table, visual은 documentId/page/table이라고 하나 공개 Evidence와 eligibility schema에는 block/table이 없다. 내부 structured-table provenance와 공개 citation 중 어느 경계의 형식인지 명시되지 않는다.
alternativeInterpretations: 공개 evidence에 block/table 필드를 추가해 native 위치를 보존한다.
기존 Evidence 계약을 따라 Word는 quote만, PDF는 page+quote만 노출하고 block/table은 내부에만 둔다.
issues.requiredDecision: 내부 table indexing, 모델 eligibility evidence, normalized public evidence 각각의 타입과 변환을 지정하고 공개 가능한 Word/PDF native 위치 예시를 제공한다.
issues.resolution: 03 §13.1 and internal-pipeline distinguish private block/table provenance from the public/eligibility citation allowlist; Word uses quote-only and PDF uses page+quote without synthetic A1 coordinates.

issues.problem: 분석 완료 Document의 modelParts/sourceSheets/sourceRows/private analysis 반환 컨테이너와 profile→DTO 변환이 없다. criteria inventory sheet/region 입력 타입도 필수 키·주소·region ID 형태가 없는 설명으로 남아 있다.
alternativeInterpretations: profile-native sparse rows와 typed value를 그대로 전달한다.
normalized cell/text 배열이나 Map으로 변환하고 blank/sentinel을 새로 만든다.
issues.requiredDecision: AnalyzedDocument, model parts, sheet/row/cell, criteria inventory/region DTO와 변환 예제를 명시한다. 원래 행·셀 주소, 빈 셀, 수식/cache/sentinel 및 읽기 한도 보존 규칙도 포함한다.
issues.resolution: 02 §2.3–2.4 and internal-pipeline provide concrete stored/analyzed document, model parts, source sheet/row, profile conversion, inventory region and detail DTOs.

issues.problem: 취소 뒤 run event와 terminal activity report는 차단되지만 늦은 E2B kill 실패는 CLEANUP_FAILED로 사용자에게 보여야 한다. 취소 응답 시점·활동 terminal 시점·오류 공개 경로가 없다.
alternativeInterpretations: 취소 즉시 모두 terminal로 만들고 뒤 cleanup 실패는 서버 로그만 보관한다.
cleanup까지 activity를 비종료로 두거나 cancelled snapshot에 별도 오류 필드를 붙인다.
issues.requiredDecision: run은 cancelled를 유지하면서 cleanup 대기·실패를 어느 activity 상태/공개 필드/연결로 언제 전달하는지 명시한다. slot은 cleanup settle까지 보존한다.
issues.resolution: 01 §8 and 02 §2.8 keep the global E2B task nonterminal through kill. Late kill failure is failed/cleanup activity via GET/SSE while the run remains cancelled and late run events stay blocked.

issues.problem: 로컬 XLSX 한도 초과는 deferred preview라고 하지만 DocumentPreview에 해당 상태나 retained-content 정책이 없다.
alternativeInterpretations: 빈 table sheets와 truncated=true/warning을 반환한다.
이미 읽은 부분 시트 또는 text fallback을 반환한다.
issues.requiredDecision: 각 source cap에서 정확한 public preview JSON과 partial retained content/경고 정책을 지정한다.
issues.resolution: 01 §4.1 and 02 §2.2 provide exact accepted201 deferred text preview/private source result, discard partial sourceSheets and retain original bytes for sandbox analysis.

issues.problem: 매 attempt의 deterministic 검사에 최초 context chunk 누락이 포함되나 repair 검증 성공 시 contextSegmentsRead를 전체로 바꾸고 initial count만 유지한다고 한다. 최초 실패가 해소 가능한지 불분명하다.
alternativeInterpretations: 최초 실패는 sticky여서 repair해도 verified가 불가능하다.
전체 replacement 검증 성공 시 최초 실패는 이력만 남고 현재 issue는 해제한다.
issues.requiredDecision: 최초 누락 진단이 현재 완료 gate에서 해제되는 정확한 조건을 지정하고 초기 1구간 실패→repair 복구 예시를 추가한다.
issues.resolution: 02 §2.5 and pipeline-prompts make initial missing-chunk state recoverable only after a validated full replacement, then verify every retained segment; initial statistics and sourceTruncated remain preserved.

issues.problem: 단일 응답 structure 상한160, 결합 context 상한1000, repair는 전체 context 대체라는 세 규칙에서 repair 응답의 상한이 결정되지 않는다.
alternativeInterpretations: repair도 단일 응답이므로160개만 허용한다.
repair는 combined context replacement여서1000개까지 허용한다.
issues.requiredDecision: repair 전용 상한과 160개 이상 기존 context를 안전하게 보존하거나 partial로 남기는 정책을 명시한다.
issues.resolution: 02 §2.4–2.5 and pipeline-prompts distinguish replacement structure≤160 from combined/public≤1000;161 replacement rejects, retains old context and returns needs_review.

issues.problem: dashboard immutable sourceItems가 presence/missingVerified를 버린다. missing 원문 색칠 방지는 이 필드가 필요하고 null→빈 문자열 변환은 legacy missing 인식에도 걸리지 않는다.
alternativeInterpretations: 정확한 snapshot allowlist를 지켜 contextual target evidence가 일반 highlight가 된다.
명세에 없는 missing 메타데이터/안전 highlight projection을 추가한다.
issues.requiredDecision: snapshot/sourceItems에 missing 필드를 보존하거나 별도의 검증된 highlight projection을 지정한다. value=null 또는 빈 문자열+presence=missing+문맥 target 근거의 왕복 예제를 추가한다.
issues.resolution: DECISIONS D18 and05 D02/D05a make DB-H01/02/03 REQUIRED_REBUILD, with observed defects retained only as negative controls. Projection, semantic scopes and mandatory gate precedence are explicit. The subsequent D05a/D05b independent judge, approved-only host merge and shared three-call budget also resolve R2-CORE-011; model-quality limits remain explicit.

issues.problem: 좌표 우선과 quote-only 전체 셀 탐색은 있지만 좌표의 실제 값과 quote 일치 및 record/item anchor 검증이 없다. 요구사항 CORE14 C04의 wrong-location/header/other-row 거절을 독립 구현할 수 없다.
alternativeInterpretations: B3=10인데 cell=B3,quote=99이면 좌표대로 B3를 칠한다. quote-only 99는 여러 행을 모두 칠한다.
실제 quote/항목 record를 검증하고 불일치면 위치 확인만 표시한다.
issues.requiredDecision: 형식별 highlight admission predicate를 지정한다. multi-cell quote, repeated value, header-only, 서로 다른 record, PDF 지정 page와 rendered page의 일치 조건을 포함한다.
issues.resolution: Required interaction I9.1 now specifies independently checked source-hash/record metadata, unique sheet and full bounds, exact cell quote with numeric-token boundaries, verified item/unit anchors, and atomic per-item rejection without relocation or verdict changes. Twenty TABLE-HIGHLIGHT-REBUILD fixtures cover positive and negative paths. D1.3 separately fixes PDF page admission; D18 makes the new rule mandatory.

issues.problem: bridge wire payload는 channel/type/token/itemId만인데 acceptance는 runId 검증을 요구한다.
alternativeInterpretations: 토큰과 iframe source 및 item membership만 검증한다.
runId를 새 필수 필드로 추가하고 없는 메시지를 거절한다.
issues.requiredDecision: runId를 transport/receiver 모두에 명시하거나 token의 immutable run/dashboard binding과 preview 교체 정리로 동등성을 검증하도록 acceptance를 명시적으로 정정한다.
issues.resolution: CORE14C05 and CHANGES match the preview-token bridge.05 D07 specifies source/origin/channel/type/token/item allowlist, immutable preview binding and listener cleanup; no wire runId is required.

issues.problem: command stdout의 partial-line framing, final stdout replay 소유권, 중복 키, 허용 설치 진단 규칙이 없다. 같은 설치가 두 번처럼 보이는 것과 실제 반복 command를 구별하지 못한다.
alternativeInterpretations: callback와 final output의 모든 발생을 별도 log로 기록한다.
정규화 text 또는 stage/current로 dedup하여 실제 반복 작업도 지울 수 있다.
issues.requiredDecision: command별 line buffering·parse·dedup key·stream/final ownership·malformed line 정책과 허용 진단을 정하고 중복/정당한 반복 trace 예제를 제공한다.
issues.resolution: 02 §2.9 and07 §7.7 define channel buffers, partial-line framing, allowlisted progress/install diagnostics, dedup key, stream versus final aggregate ownership, limits and finish flushing.

issues.problem: criteria-analysis dock의 autoCollapse 기본값을 기존 구현에서 확인하라고 남겨 패키지만으로 종료 후 상태를 결정할 수 없다.
alternativeInterpretations: criteria-analysis도 기본 true여서800ms 후 접힌다.
기본 false여서 완료 후에도 열린다.
issues.requiredDecision: 각 host의 autoCollapse 값을 패키지에 직접 명시한다.
issues.resolution: 04 §4.2 explicitly defaults autoCollapse to false and enables it only for target review; no original source lookup is needed.

issues.resolution: 02 §2.5 now specifies source_limit→limited for incomplete/missing/mismatched selections and needs_review for selector absence, exceptions or replacement failures unless source_limit already applies.

Insert then prune, leaving40 and evicting the oldest terminal.

issues.problem: Reduced motion clears active+pending can include OS-only reduction, whereas04/I5 say only app OFF clears JS and OS preference changes CSS.

Only app OFF clears; OS-only preference leaves queue state running.

issues.section: D05a semantic changes validation; prompts/dashboard-loop REQUIRED_REBUILD override
issues.problem: A model-generated changes mask can self-authorize unrelated fields. For instruction '범례 아래로', both legend=bottom and theme=dark with basis=semantic and the same exact span pass the listed structural checks, while the prose says span meaning must justify each change.
alternativeInterpretations: Trust the planner's semantic attribution after schema/scope/span checks; accept both declared changes.
Independently validate that each span entails its field/value and reject or repair the unrelated theme change.
issues.requiredDecision: Assign semantic intent validation to a concrete stage or explicitly delimit the model trust guarantee; specify this adversarial envelope's acceptance, repair and budget behavior.
issues.resolution: 05 D05a–D05b and dashboard-loop explicitly require an independent semantic judge before the mask, with approvedChanges-only host merge. Planner/judge/retries share three total calls; no judge budget forbids generated success. SEM-UNREQUESTED-THEME specifies actual-judge rejection and separate mock host checks, while documenting that mistaken semantic judgments remain possible.
